title: View DevTools
subtitle: Owner · signals · misuse ·
healthOk: No misuse warnings in the current scan.
healthWarnHint: Click a warning to jump to the Owner path in Tree.
selectNode: Select a node to inspect subscriptions.
noDomForNode: No connected DOM for this Owner.
upstreamHint: Upstream = Observer→Source edges on Effects/Memos. Downstream = Source→Observer edges on Memos.
hmrClaimed: Capsule hidden while this overlay is mounted (claimUi).
hmrNoBridge: No HMR bridge yet — standalone capsule (if any) stays visible.
settingsHint: Drag the header or the floating button to reposition. Position & prefs persist in localStorage ({storageKey}). Esc closes. Production builds never mount this overlay. When the DEV HMR bridge is present, its status appears under Overview → HMR and the standalone server capsule is suppressed.
noOwnerRootsHint: In DEV: wrap mount with createRootTracked((d) => …), call trackRoot(getOwner()), or pass owner to mountDevtoolsOverlay({ owner }). Examples dogfood uses createRootTracked in main.tsx.
